targeting_and_scaling.target_rule: Normal samples three of five flags; Heroic all five; inactive creatures receive Unresponsive aura and lose release interaction.
Local SpellScript randomly resizes the destination list to one; Dancing Flames removes targets at <=40yd or >=100yd from caster before random selection.
Local boss uses DoCastAOE; exact target radius and mode target filtering are spell-data questions.
Guides report higher heroic health/damage and 8% rather than 6% Malevolent Strikes; no complete current four-mode coefficient table is available.

phase_reset_credit.behavior: JustAppeared applies active Halfus buffs and spawns setup group 462.
Encounter frame engage; world state 5607 reset; Berserk scheduled; Proto-Behemoth zoned into combat; drake entries updated; active whelp cage made selectable; Storm Shadow Nova scheduled.
Instance ProcessEvent forwards release events to ACTION_DRAGON_FREED; whelp cage grid-searches eight whelps; released actors cast counter-debuff, Bind Will, and engage players.
Non-whelp death casts Dragon's Vengeance via Proto-Behemoth; whelp deaths count to eight before one cast.
Base evade, summon cleanup, encounter disengage, setup group despawn, and _DespawnAtEvade; private Halfus counters are not explicitly reset in the class.
_JustDied, encounter disengage, setup group despawn; DATA_HALFUS_WYRMBREAKER DONE notifies Cho'gall progression dialogue.
Map 671; Halfus 44600 maps to DATA_HALFUS_WYRMBREAKER=0; doors 205222/205223; loader calls AddSC_boss_halfus_wyrmbreaker.
